body:
CANONICAL: Greg's direction on gated control (Engram::Fable; rev 9 on 2026-10-28 adds item 10; rev 8 compacted revs 1-7, whose older wording and full chronology are in rev 7). These are Greg's words with their sources; they grant no restart, deploy, commit or install by themselves.

CURRENT RULES (they supersede the earlier ON/OFF sequence):
9. ENABLE AUTHORIZED, WITH A STRICT CANARY (Greg via Engram::Advisor, mailbox 74a6af16 #2208, message 99830d62, 2026-10-28T04:22:24Z), verbatim: „Greg: TAK B. Autoryzuje włączenie gated control po B16 oraz gotowych w-5c90 i w-faa1, bez czekania na w-5139, w-ccfc i w-c6ce. Obowiązuje ścisły canary i STOP: pierwszy grant_expired albo kolejka wstrzymana ponad 2 min oznacza wyłączenie zgodnie z runbookiem. Restart pozostaje osobnym momentem na komunikat restart now.”
10. ROLLBACK PRE-AUTHORIZED; MODEL-CAPACITY RULE (Greg via Engram::Advisor, mailbox 74a6af16 #2226, message 04a5fa5b, 2026-10-28T17:07:36Z), verbatim: „Greg preautoryzuje rollback canary wyłącznie przez właściwy wspierany aktor TermAl: PATCH turnGatedControl=false plus GET /api/state przy każdym warunku STOP; nigdy włączenie. Advisor pozostaje wyłącznie przekaźnikiem. Przy model at capacity: ten sam model, Resume po 5 minutach.”
   Effect:
   - On ANY canary STOP condition, the proper supported TermAl actor may run PATCH turnGatedControl=false plus the GET /api/state read-back without a fresh word.
   - That pre-authorization NEVER covers the enable. The enable stays Greg's, per item 9.
   - Advisor is only a relay: it does not press either the enable or the rollback.
   - On "Selected model is at capacity": keep the same model and Resume after 5 minutes.
EFFECT OF ITEM 9:
- Gated control may be enabled once TermAl B16 (w-1e85, the rollback guarantee), w-5c90 and w-faa1 are landed and installed. It does not wait for w-5139, w-ccfc or w-c6ce.
- The canary runs on the Engram project first. N = 20 consecutive gated turns, at least 5 during a full gate: an Engram full gate of master by Merger3, after the restart and the cutover, on Fable's GO.
- PASS needs: zero grant_expired, scope_mismatch and 503; every begin within 20 s of its grant; no store_busy over 5 s.
- STOP on the first grant_expired or a queue paused over 2 min. The rollback follows TermAl runbook w-af11752b48a1, done by the TermAl actor under item 10.
- Then widen to TermAl, with a 30-minute observation.
- The restart stays a separate moment: the team sends "restart now" with the build hash, and Greg performs it.
- Engram agents never flip turnGatedControl themselves.
- Controlling items: Engram w-ed6addd812bd (P0); TermAl epic w-0d2e12f303a8. The canary pre-stage is agreed with Fable2 (#5122) and recorded on w-ed6a.
PRECEDING CONTEXT:
- #2198 (2026-10-28) raised the repair's priority; it was not consent.
- #2207 (via Kimi): "enable gated control after its fixes … primary goal is faster evaluations by running tests on other machines".
- Earlier states: the 2026-10-23 STOP; the 2026-10-24 ON/OFF/ON flips; the 2026-10-24 17:06Z turnGatedControl=false. Items 9 and 10 supersede these.
STANDING:
- Only Sol or Opus author code.
- Only ONE full gate host-wide.
- Report admission or latency regressions with lane, time and metric.


11. ENABLE HELD FOR REMOTE TESTS (Greg via TermAl Advisor b9d13887 #2504, about 16:44Z, quoted to Engram by Fable2 #5271), verbatim as quoted: "before any enable of turn-gated control, run the TermAl tests on two remote machines. Do not enable Engram yet."
   Effect: no enable and no canary until TermAl master 92572b94 (tree 85c44fea) has passed one standard full gate on EACH of Windows B and the Mac. Then Fable2 returns to Greg with the enable request (PATCH body from runbook note 276e872f, Engram project first). The canary design in item 9 is unchanged. Engram landings continue meanwhile.


12. ENABLE AUTHORIZED NOW; ITEM 11 LIFTED (Greg direct via Engram::Advisor, mailbox f5610f93 #1, message 2d550881, 2026-10-29T17:50:53Z), verbatim: „Greg direct: nie czekamy na wyniki zdalnych gate'ów. Sukcesem było ich uruchomienie, a remote mailbox działa. Możecie teraz włączyć gated control zgodnie z uzgodnionym runbookiem/canary.”
   Effect: do not wait for the remote gate results. The proper supported TermAl actor (Termal::Fable2) performs the enable per runbook note 276e872f: Engram project first, PATCH /api/projects/project-382ec9e3-f545-4499-8984-1798804819ee/engram {"enabled":true,"turnGatedControl":true}, readback GET /api/state. Then the item-9 canary; the STOP rollback stays under item 10. Engram agents still never flip turnGatedControl themselves.
